assurance_contract.scope: Consuming-path verification of positive Trust Task responses and refusal handling at the pinned OpenVTC VTI/VTN boundary.
assurance_contract.non_scope: No claim about other deployments, trust graphs, unobserved clients or external upstream acceptance.
assurance_propositions: Unverified positive responses cannot cause authoritative network effects.
Refusals and unavailable verification cannot become positive network authorization.

actions.action: Obtain source-pinned native VTN consumer positive, negative, retry and refusal evidence for both residual requirements.
actions.acceptance_criterion: Both DTG-0001-R1 and DTG-0001-R2 have independently inspectable provenance and failing countercases before a comparable assessment rerun.
